text: So ɓe kawrii e ɓeen goonɗinɓe ɓe mbi'a: min njaɓii ko ngoonɗin-ɗon ko, ɓe mbi'a noon sabu hulde goonɗinɓe ɓe, si ɓe njahii ɓe njeewdii e hooreeɓe maɓɓe ɓee, ɓe teentinana ɓe tabital e jokkude ɓe, e wiide ɓe: ko onon min ngondi e laawol mon, kono tan miɗen peññinana goonɗinɓe ɓen jaɓde amen, min njala ɓe min njalkita.
